paragraphs.text: Cape Tempest is the wooded nation at the eastern tip of North Aerona on Dominaria .
Unlike the waste west of it, Cape Tempest is habitable because of the sea climate and the freshwater supply of a large river. The windy cape connects the Sea of Whales with the Rip .

In the K'Cur Mountains lies Teeka 's Shop of Wonders. On the eastern side of Cape Tempest lies the mysterious Coraleon , the city of continued festival, where every emotion is celebrated. Recently the region has deteriorated.
